collectionMethod: 以 chrome-devtools MCP 在獨立瀏覽器 context（isolatedContext=longines-hk-market）開啟 LONGINES 香港官方站 https://www.longines.com/hk/watches。頁面 __NEXT_DATA__ props.pageProps.products 顯示 total_count=493 與第 1 頁 24 筆；htmlLang=hk、defaultParams.filters.category_uid.eq=NA==（與台灣站相同的「腕錶」分類 uid，因與 TW 共用同一 Magento 商品目錄，僅 store/lang 不同）。經檢視同源商品頁請求（CartProductDetails 等）確認 store: zh_hk、lang: zh-hk 為 HK 官方 store view。於同一頁面 session 內以與台灣站相同的 ProductList query 文字（取自頁面既有 GraphQL 操作，未自行改寫欄位），改用 store: zh_hk / lang: zh-hk 標頭與 cache_buster_store=zh_hk / cache_buster_lang=zh-hk 變數逐頁請求 https://www.longines.com/api/graphql，直到 currentPage × pageSize ≥ total_count，並額外請求下一頁以取得官方「超出可用頁數」錯誤作為停止證據。錶殼材質與錶盤顏色為選項 ID，以商品頁 __NEXT_DATA__ props.fallback 中鍵值 '@"ProductAttributes","hk",' 的官方 attribute_options（zh-hk）標籤對應成文字；20 筆獨立抽查另以商品頁 schema.org JSON-LD（width/material/color/price/priceCurrency/sku）交叉核對，全數一致。

graphqlRequest.queryText: query ProductList($pageSize: Int = 24 $currentPage: Int = 1 $filters: ProductAttributeFilterInput! $sort: ProductAttributeSortInput!) { products( pageSize: $pageSize currentPage: $currentPage filter: $filters sort: $sort ) { ...ProductListContent } } fragment ProductListContent on Products { total_count akamai_tag page_info { current_page page_size } ...ProductListItems ...ProductListToolbar } fragment ProductListItems on Products { items { ...ProductCardFull } } fragment ProductCardFull on ProductInterface { ...ProductCard ...ProductConfiguratorFragment ...WatchComparatorSummaryItem } fragment ProductCard on ProductInterface { __typename attribute_set_id url_key sku product_sku name tag custom_tags case_dimension case_material mvt_fct_type description_sunglasses_description description_color dimensions_width_bracelet dimensions_width_bracelet_range filter_width_strap filter_interchangeable material_cluster preferred_category { tagline_product ...PreferredCategoryFragment tagline_product } small_image { path label } thumbnail { path label } image { ...MediaGalleryItem } ...ProductStatus ...ProductPrice ...ProductDataLayerAttributes ... on ConfigurableProduct { ...ConfigurableProductCardFragment } categories { uid name url_path tagline_product } ...ProductGalleryFragment ...ProductVariations } fragment PreferredCategoryFragment on CategoryInterface { uid name url_path breadcrumbs { category_level category_uid category_name category_url_path } default_category { name } } fragment MediaGalleryItem on MediaGalleryInterface { __typename ...MediaGalleryImage ... on ProductVideo { video_content { video_description video_title video_url } } } fragment MediaGalleryImage on MediaGalleryInterface { path } fragment ProductStatus on ProductInterface { __typename uid sku product_sku attribute_set_id stock_status purchasable crcorporate crretailer live_appointment preorder_is_enabled concierge limited_edition find_retailer general_cites sold_out cta_action cta_label cta_url_slug } fragment ProductPrice on ProductInterface { base_price { ...CartMoneyFragment } special_price } fragment CartMoneyFragment on Money { value currency value_formatted currency_symbol } fragment ProductDataLayerAttributes on ProductInterface { bracelet_color bracelet_interchangeability bracelet_material case_dimension case_material case_shape case_water_resistance description_color dial_color dial_specificities dimensions_width_bracelet filter_related_collections mvt_fct_functions mvt_fct_type } fragment ConfigurableProductCardFragment on ConfigurableProduct { uid product_sku attribute_set_id default_buckle variants { ...ConfigurableProductCardOptionsFragment } } fragment ConfigurableProductCardOptionsFragment on ConfigurableVariant { product { uid product_sku sku stock_status ...ProductPrice } } fragment ProductGalleryFragment on ProductInterface { media_gallery { __typename label position disabled url top_gallery bottom_gallery ... on ProductImage { size { height width } } } } fragment ProductVariations on ProductInterface { ...ProductVariationsItem related_products { ...ProductVariationsItem } } fragment ProductVariationsItem on ProductInterface { attribute_set_id url_key uid sku description_color dial_color bracelet_material bracelet_color description_hexadecimal_colors { code } dial_hexadecimal_color { code } bracelet_hexadecimal_color { code } image { ...MediaGalleryImage } small_image { ...MediaGalleryImage } thumbnail { ...MediaGalleryImage } nightmode_image { ...MediaGalleryImage } } fragment ProductConfiguratorFragment on ProductInterface { attribute_set_id url_key related_dial_products { sku } related_strap_products { sku } } fragment WatchComparatorSummaryItem on ProductInterface { sku name thumbnail { ...MediaGalleryItem } ...ProductSummaryDescriptionFragment ...ProductPrice } fragment ProductSummaryDescriptionFragment on ProductInterface { attribute_set_id product_sku case_dimension dimensions_width_bracelet } fragment ProductListToolbar on Products { aggregations { __typename label count attribute_code options { __typename label value count } } sort_fields { default options { label value direction } } }
graphqlRequest.note: query 文字取自台灣市場既有 evidence 中頁面自身發出的 ProductList 請求（同一 Magento GraphQL schema，經 HK 商品頁 network request 標頭核實 store/lang 欄位名稱一致），改用 HK store/lang 參數重放；未自行改寫欄位；未保存 Cookie 或其他認證資訊。

marketConfirmation.note: 官方 StoreConfig（自商品頁 __NEXT_DATA__ props.fallback['@"StoreConfig","hk",'] 讀取）為 default_country_code=HK、locale=zh_Hant_HK、base_currency_code=HKD、store_code=zh_hk；493 筆 base_price.currency 全為 HKD。

errors: currentPage value 22 specified is greater than the 21 page(s) available.
